overview_description.description:
Global Feeder Shipping provides container feeder operations through an integrated network of services connecting major shipping hubs to their surrounding markets. Its priority is the continuous improvement of its services, systems, and processes to empower its clients to continue serving the global trade. 

The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
